name: Living Music Score
description: A musician’s notebook writes itself, then sings. Three original melodies, an attentive pen, and a score you can make your own.

assets.credit: Original composition and procedural musical handwriting
Caveat handwriting outlines · Pablo Impallari and the Caveat project authors

compatibility: Modern browsers with SVG, Pointer Events and Web Audio. No WebGL, external samples, CDN or runtime package is required.
Sound is off on arrival. Press Play to create and resume AudioContext. Stop, pause, mute, volume and silent writing work independently.
Desktop wheel/trackpad, touch dragging, keyboard and slider controls. Compose includes an accessible HTML event selector alongside clickable notation.
One treble-clef voice, G3–E6, 3/4 or 4/4, eighth through whole notes, dots, rests, accidentals, beams and ties. No chords, tuplets or multiple voices.
Hidden/offscreen playback pauses and requires Play to continue. Disposal stops scheduled voices, timers and animation frames and closes the audio context.
notes: Three short original melodies share structured events between notation, procedural audio and MIDI. No commercial recording or existing melody is sampled.

A restricted notation engine places notes diatonically, groups eighths within beats, maintains accidentals per measure, and ties notes split by bar lines or strong beats. Final incomplete bars receive rests.
Staff, clefs, note heads, stems, beams, rests and annotations are real stroke paths, with deterministic irregularity and pressure changes. The tool tip follows the very path currently being drawn.
Scroll to Write reverses the drawing silently. Play uses the AudioContext clock for both scheduled notes and visual progress. Future symbols are prepared just ahead of their sounding notes.
Compose changes actual events. Edits reflow the notation, change the sound, and are included in locally saved Lab presets and the source package.
Export a complete vector score, PNG, composition JSON, MIDI or replayable drawing recipe. Importing a composition never enables sound.
reuse: Open example.html in the exported ZIP through local HTTP. No install or build is needed.
Use createScoreDrawing for the SVG instrument, createScoreAudio for gesture-activated playback, and music.js for normalized composition events.
The layout, handwriting, audio scheduler and export modules are independent. See embed-demo.html for a small music-website integration.
README.md documents schemas, notation scope, exact timing, pause/seek, local persistence and resource cleanup.
